faq.question: How do you protect against Seattle's moisture?
faq.answer: All our units are built with vapor-barrier walls and sealed concrete floors. The facility is dehumidified and kept well-ventilated to prevent mold and moisture damage.

faq.question: Do you sell packing supplies?
faq.answer: Yes! Our front office carries boxes in multiple sizes, packing tape, bubble wrap, stretch wrap, and padlocks. No need to make a separate trip to a hardware store.

faq.question: Is 24/7 access available?
faq.answer: Our facility hours are 7am–9pm weekdays and 8am–7pm weekends. After-hours access can be arranged for business tenants — please ask at the office.
